create_single_scene_sampler: create a SingleSceneSampler with a scene path string and call sample to return it
create_multi_scene_sampler: create a MultiSceneSampler with a list of scene paths and sample random scenes uniformly
create_balanced_scene_sampler: create a BalancedSceneSampler with scene list and episode count to evenly distribute episodes across scenes
sample_scene_from_sampler: call sample on any SceneSampler subclass to get the next scene string for episode generation
set_balanced_sampler_episode: call set_cur_episode on BalancedSceneSampler to advance which scene is returned by subsequent sample calls
